title: Research home, search thread, library, activity and settings
description: Unified composer home, search results as a research thread of paper cards with saved state, library with dropzone and URL filter, readable activity with paper links and retry, polished settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given the home composer, when a topic is submitted, then the query is recorded in search history and results render as paper cards with title, authors, year, abstract and links.
Given a result already in the library, then the card shows In library with Open; saving another result shows Saved to library without duplicating.
Given a library paper chosen as composer context, when a question is submitted, then the paper workspace opens on a new chat and streams the answer.
Given a failed ingest job, when Retry processing is pressed on Activity, then the job is queued again and links to its paper.
test_cases: research RTL: save, rate limit, saved flag
library RTL: filter in URL, upload dropzone validation
verification: Research agent: 20 tests written first and all red against the legacy pages. Most failed on the missing new page; two were genuine behavioural reds (the rate-limit copy and the empty-library link). Later reds: home suggestions, a dropped space in an accessible name, and a background refetch 429 alert. Not test-first, stated by the agent: 56d6dab visual fixes and about 12 smaller behaviours. A test-after coverage task is in progress. Lead: useSavePaper now marks saved hits in place instead of re-querying providers (78609a5; red: saved_paper_id stayed null). Full-suite 1 s timeouts under 12 workers were fixed with asyncUtilTimeout 3000; 3 consecutive runs passed 150/150. E2E research.spec is written, pending a serial run. Test-after coverage (labelled as such in the commits and file headers): 27 tests, 25 mutations, every targeted test went red. The mutation run exposed a timing-dependent load-error test: shared /models refetch on mount let Settings recover without a retry. All three load-error tests now fail until the retry. The agent corrected its earlier ToggleGroup claim. Lead integration: 205/205 in two consecutive full runs. The last three gaps (Load more errors, the 'did not finish' line, Activity retrying) are in progress.
